meta.name: cavecrew
meta.description: Decision guide for delegating to caveman-style subagents. Tells the main thread WHEN to spawn `cavecrew-investigator` (locate code), `cavecrew-builder` (1-2 file edit), or `cavecrew-reviewer` (diff review) instead of doing the work inline or using vanilla `Explore`. Subagent output is caveman-compressed so the tool-result injected back into main context is ~60% smaller — main context lasts longer across long sessions. Trigger: "delegate to subagent", "use cavecrew", "spawn investigator/builder/reviewer", "save context", "compressed agent output".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用压缩子代理输出节省主上下文空间
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在长会话中通过子代理分工并节省上下文空间。
copy.tagline_en: Save main context with compressed subagent output
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to delegate tasks to subagents and conserve context in long sessions.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会使用三个子代理（调查员、构建者、审查员）来执行代码定位、编辑和审查任务。子代理的输出经过压缩，比普通方式节省约60%的上下文空间，让长对话中主上下文更持久。
howto.when: 当你提到“委托给子代理”、“使用cavecrew”、“生成调查员/构建者/审查员”、“节省上下文”、“压缩代理输出”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 使用cavecrew调查员，找出函数calculateTotal的定义位置。
say.note: 触发调查员子代理，返回文件路径和行号。

say.text: 用cavecrew构建者，修复bug.py第42行的拼写错误。
say.note: 触发构建者子代理，执行小范围编辑。

say.text: 用cavecrew审查员，审查当前分支的差异。
say.note: 触发审查员子代理，返回问题列表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses three subagents (investigator, builder, reviewer) for code locating, editing, and reviewing. Subagent output is compressed, saving ~60% context space, making main context last longer in long sessions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "delegate to subagent", "use cavecrew", "spawn investigator/builder/reviewer", "save context", or "compressed agent output".

say_en.text: Use cavecrew investigator to find where function calculateTotal is defined.
say_en.note: Triggers investigator subagent, returns file path and line number.

say_en.text: Use cavecrew builder to fix the typo in bug.py at line 42.
say_en.note: Triggers builder subagent for small edit.

say_en.text: Use cavecrew reviewer to review the current branch diff.
say_en.note: Triggers reviewer subagent, returns list of issues.
